mcat_description.short: Portable Huts are prefabricated, relocatable small structures built on steel or panel frames, sold as complete units or per sq ft, used as site offices, security cabins, labour accommodations, tea stalls, and eco-resort shelters.
mcat_description.long: Portable Huts are factory-manufactured, modular shelter units designed for rapid on-site assembly and easy relocation without permanent civil foundation work. They are constructed using structural frames of mild steel or GI sections clad with insulated wall and roof panels — including PUF sandwich panels, Aerocon panels, GI colour-coated sheets, FRP panels, or cemented panels — and are supplied as complete turnkey units with doors, windows, and optional electrical fittings. In the Indian B2B market, they serve a wide range of applications from construction site labour camps and security guard posts to eco-tourism resort cottages, farm houses, and temporary commercial kiosks. Buyers typically specify material type, panel thickness, floor size (in sq ft), insulation grade, and intended use when enquiring.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, portable huts are a well-established segment of the prefabricated structures industry, with manufacturers concentrated in Delhi-NCR (Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida), Rajasthan (Jodhpur), Maharashtra, and Gujarat. The dominant commercial form is a steel-framed, insulated-panel portable cabin used for construction site labour accommodation, security guard posts, and site offices — corroborated by EPACK Prefab, EcoPrefab, Ercon Prefabs, and Supersun Prefab manufacturer sites. Panel material is the primary differentiator: PUF sandwich panels offer superior thermal insulation; GI colour-coated panels are the most economical; Aerocon and cemented panels offer fire resistance; FRP panels are used for lightweight and corrosion-resistant applications including frangible aviation huts. Tata Steel's Nest-In (MobiNest) is a notable branded entrant in the steel-based portable cabin segment, validating the category's commercial maturity. Structures are built as per IS standards per EPACK Prefab (single source — low confidence for specific IS standard number). The eco-tourism and resort cottage sub-segment (bamboo huts, wooden log cabins, glamping pods) is a growing niche driven by hospitality sector demand, corroborated by Loom Crafts and EcoPrefab manufacturer sites. Buyers in the industrial/construction segment prioritise relocatability, assembly speed, and insulation grade; hospitality buyers prioritise aesthetics, material (bamboo/wood), and customisation.
